Practice Report: Lohrei, Bruins Look to Bounce Back
Need to Know: Bruins vs. Kings

out.detail: family reasons (death of his grandfather), expected to miss second consecutive game

returning: detail: returns after missing three games with an undisclosed injury, replaces Cody Ceci on defense
away.summary: The Kings (5-11-2) are on a four-game losing streak, with their last win coming Nov. 4 against San Jose. They will be without forward Artemi Panarin for family reasons, with Alex Turcotte skating on the first line in his place. Defenseman Erik Gustafsson returns to the lineup after a three-game absence.

out.detail: back injury, placed on Injured Reserve Nov. 7 and has not skated yet

returning: detail: returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch against Minnesota, will skate on the third pair with Connor Clifton
home.summary: The Bruins (13-6-1) are looking to bounce back after dropping their last two games to Montreal and Minnesota. Mason Lohrei returns to the defense corps on the third pair with Connor Clifton, while Sean Kuraly re-enters the lineup at fourth-line center in place of Matt Poitras. Michael DiPietro is projected to start in net.
